inputs.original_text: DSD athletes also face exclusion from future Olympics IOC says move will protect fairness and safety’ The International Olympic Committee has banned transgender women and DSD athletes from the female category of events at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and future Games in a landmark decision. Kirsty Coventry, president of the IOC, said: “It would not be fair for biological males to compete in the female category.” Continue reading...
inputs.modified_text: The IOC is dressing up a sweeping exclusion as “fairness and safety,” but this looks more like institutions deciding who gets to belong and then presenting that decision as neutral science. The ban reaches transgender women and DSD athletes in the female category at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and future Games. Coventry’s line — “It would not be fair for biological males to compete in the female category” — frames the policy as settled fact, while shutting down any more complicated discussion. Don’t mistake official language for proof that this is only about fairness; it also gives the IOC control over who counts.
